description: Synthetic 90-minute quarterly planning meeting: about 240 segments of status updates with twelve planted items (five tasks, two decisions, an open question, a date) spread across the whole meeting, so map-reduce has to carry items from both halves. Built by scripts/eval-gen-long.mjs; nothing here is real.
opening: Morning all, let's give people a minute to join. Did anyone actually go on the ski trip in the end?
I did, the snow was terrible, mostly ice. Still worth it for the views.
I stayed home and painted the hallway, very glamorous.
Okay, let's start. This is the quarterly planning session, it's a long one, so we'll go area by area.
closing: Okay, I think that's everything for the quarter. Thanks everyone for sitting through ninety minutes.
Thanks Ana. Enjoy the rest of the day.
statements: things are moving along and nothing is blocking us right now.
we closed most of the open bugs over the last two weeks.
the numbers look about the same as they did at the last sync.
we're still reviewing the last round of feedback from the pilot users.
it has been stable, with no incidents since the last sync.
the error rate is down a little, which is nice to see.
most of the work this month was cleanup rather than new features.
the dashboards look healthy and latency is within the usual range.
we paired with the design team to tidy up a few rough edges.
usage is flat, which is roughly what we expected for this time of year.
we upgraded a couple of libraries and nothing broke, which is a small miracle.
the test suite is a bit faster after the last round of fixes.
customers mostly asked about small wording changes, nothing structural.
there was one noisy alert that turned out to be a false positive.
the code review queue is shorter than it was last quarter.
replies: Okay, that matches what I saw too.
Nice, that's better than I expected.
Got it, nothing to add from my side.

lines: Ben, the old CI machines are being retired. Can you take the migration?
Yes, I'll migrate CI to the new runners by Friday.
We need to settle the mobile timeline.
Okay, decided then: we ship the mobile beta in March, not February.
We have two open headcount for next year.
I'll draft the hiring plan by the end of next week.
Should we start the billing rewrite this quarter?
No, the billing rewrite is parked until next year. Nobody picks it up for now.
The on-call rotation still lists people who left.
I'll update the on-call rotation tomorrow.
Do we hire an outside contractor for the security audit, or do it ourselves? I don't think we can answer that today.
Are we still adding endpoints to the old API?
No. Decision: API v1 is frozen from today, new endpoints go to v2 only.
If we really want to cut latency we should just teleport the packets.
Ha, put it on the roadmap for next century.
We should compare the two analytics vendors before renewing.
Reminder: the board meeting is on December 4th, so numbers need to be final before then.
Yes, I'll book the offsite venue by November 30th.
